ai_lead: AI accelerates; judgment decides. I work with Claude Code every day, with my own skills, memory and rules. This is a normal session:
term_investigate: on a failure, evidence and hypotheses first; code comes after
term_patch: the smallest fix, in the layer that owns the problem
term_prod: the site running in Docker exactly as in production, to test there and not live
term_skills: my own skills with each platform's rules: how a branch is created, what gets touched and what doesn't
term_lean: minimal code: if it doesn't need to be written, it isn't
term_review: every change reviewed before it is accepted
term_verify: nothing is done until it is checked
term_ctx: persistent memory plus architecture and database docs per project: the agent doesn't rediscover what is already known
term_mcp: a real browser through Playwright that I watch live · n8n
term_rules: I do the logins · nothing is published unless asked · confirm before deleting
